transcript.text: Using the "holiday total" definition: gross revenue (SUM(amount)) over completed orders with order date Nov 1 – Dec 31, 2025 inclusive.

args.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cents, COUNT(*) AS n FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
